rows.description:
In Time Tec is an award-winning IT & software company. In Time Tec offers progressive software development services, enabling its clients to keep their brightest and most valuable talent focused on innovation. In Time Tec has a leadership team averaging 15 years in software/firmware R&D, and 20 years building onshore/offshore R&D teams. We are looking for rare talent to join us. People having a positive mindset and great organizational skills will be drawn to the position. Your capacity to take initiative and solve problems as they emerge, flexibility, and honesty, will be key factors for your success at In Time Tec. 


About the Role

We are looking for engineers to build next-generation AI systems powered by Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures. This role focuses on developing intelligent systems that can reason, act, and automate complex workflows using large language models and multi-agent frameworks.

You will work on designing and delivering production-grade AI solutions, including conversational systems, document intelligence, decision automation, and AI-driven applications. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals along with hands-on experience in building, integrating, and scaling AI systems beyond prototypes.

 

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration logic, and tool-integrated agents
Build Generative AI applications using LLMs for use cases such as conversational AI, content generation, and intelligent automation
Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases and semantic search techniques
Integrate and work with multiple LLMs and AI models, selecting and optimizing them based on performance, cost, and use case requirements
Design and develop scalable backend systems and APIs to support AI applications
Implement prompt engineering strategies, structured outputs, and guardrails to improve model reliability
Evaluate, monitor, and optimise AI system performance, including accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions
Stay updated with advancements in Gen AI, agentic frameworks, and emerging AI tooling
Contribute to system documentation, architecture discussions, and knowledge sharing across teams
 

Skills Required

Core Skills

Strong programming skills in Python (and familiarity with backend frameworks)
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs in real-world applications
Experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, and document processing pipelines
Familiarity with agentic frameworks (such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar)
Understanding of API design, system architecture, and scalable backend development
Experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar)
Solid understanding of prompt engineering, model behaviour, and output control techniques

Good to Have

Experience with multi-agent systems and workflow orchestration
Exposure to knowledge graphs or hybrid retrieval systems
Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience in evaluation frameworks, monitoring tools, and model optimisation techniques
Understanding of voice-based systems (STT/TTS) or multimodal AI applications

Behavioural & Engineering Mindset

Strong problem-solving ability with a focus on building scalable, production-ready systems
Ability to work in fast-paced and ambiguous environments
Ownership mindset with attention to quality, performance, and reliability
Clear communication and ability to collaborate across teams

How You’ll Grow at In Time Tec
In Time Tec, has made significant investments to create a stimulating environment for its people to grow. We want each of our employees to grow in their way and play their roles while honing their ownership abilities. As part of those efforts, we provide our professionals with a range of educational opportunities to help them grow in their career.  

Our guiding principles of leadership, trust, transparency, and integrity serve as the foundation for everything we do and every success we achieve. We are proud of these fundamental principles since they demonstrate our dedication towards them as a “One Team”.

We value every individual by giving them the freedom to make daily decisions that can support their health, well-being, confidence, and awareness. Our leadership team is there to offer the safe base by giving the right budding environment, instruction, tools, and chances necessary for your professional development in achieving your goals.

Our people and culture work together in a collaborative environment, making In Time Tec a thriving place to work. You can find out more about Life at In Time Tec here.

Location: Remote ( Preferable if the candidate location is Bengaluru or Gurgaon)

About the Role
We are looking for talented engineers who combine strong communication, stakeholder management, and hands-on expertise in AI agents. You should be equally comfortable presenting a solution to a Fortune 500 business sponsor, working through ambiguous requirements with product managers, and building production-grade agentic workflows in code. A sense of ownership, continuous learning, and genuine curiosity about the rapidly evolving agent ecosystem are essential.

At Flexday AI, you will design, build, and deploy production-grade Agentic AI solutions for large enterprise clients. We are a multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and multi-LLM (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) AI solutions firm, and you will work with global teams across the full development lifecycle, from discovery to production.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with client stakeholders, product owners, and business leads to understand requirements, shape solutions, and communicate progress clearly and credibly
Design and develop Agentic AI solutions deployed at enterprise scale
Translate functional and business requirements into technical solutions in collaboration with product and business teams
Build, test, and deploy AI components on AWS, Azure, or GCP
Take end-to-end ownership of features, from development through production
Collaborate with remote, cross-functional global teams across multiple time zones

Required Skills
1. Communication and Stakeholder Management (Primary Requirement)

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders
Comfort facilitating working sessions, leading solution walkthroughs, and managing expectations with client sponsors
Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and follow-through
Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

2. Agentic AI (Primary Technical Requirement)

Solid working knowledge of AI agents, agentic workflows, and the patterns behind them, such as tool use, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration
Hands-on experience building agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent (professional or personal projects both count)
Understanding of how to evaluate, debug, and productionize agent behavior in enterprise settings
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and multi-agent orchestration patterns is strongly preferred

3. AI Specialization (Deep Expertise in at Least One Area)

LLM and Generative AI: prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, and LLM integration
Machine Learning: classical ML, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment
Computer Vision: CNNs, detection, segmentation, vision transformers, or OCR

4. Programming and Software Engineering

2 to 5+ years of hands-on software development experience, primarily in Python
Proven contribution to large-scale programs deployed in enterprise environments
Understanding of full-stack development, REST APIs, and microservices
Disciplined approach to code quality, testing, and documentation

5. Cloud and Data

Hands-on experience developing and deploying on AWS or Azure (GCP is a plus)
Experience working with large datasets and data pipelines
Familiarity with Docker and Git

Good to Have
Enterprise Platforms

Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI

Agent Frameworks and Protocols

LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar
Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and multi-agent orchestration

RAG and Retrieval Systems

Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector)
Embedding pipelines, semantic search, and document intelligence

Data Engineering

Databricks, PySpark, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or similar platforms, with a good working understanding of the underlying concepts

DevOps and MLOps

Understanding of CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, and observability
Hands-on experience with any industry-leading MLOps tools and platforms

Qualifications

Bachelor s or Master s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field from a reputed institution.
A PhD or equivalent qualification is highly valued, and candidates with doctoral backgrounds are encouraged to apply

The Role: Founding Engineer

Your mandate is to build the core systems, advanced backend products, and engineering culture that let Frontier scale our leading enterprise automation and workflows.

This means owning complex production systems, optimizing internal operational tooling, building agent-powered workflows, and creating the structural harnesses that let engineers and operators ship software quickly and safely with AI.

You will work directly with our leadership team and senior operators on the company s highest-leverage engineering problems: end-to-end data processing speed, high-concurrency search quality, operator productivity, platform onboarding, client intelligence, and AI-assisted operations.

We are only interested in someone who takes a long-term ownership mentality to technical architecture, infrastructure stability, and core business partnerships.

Existing Tech Stack

Backend: Python (Django and FastAPI frameworks)

Database: PostgreSQL Database and associated ORM frameworks

Infrastructure: AWS Services and/or Railway cloud architectures

AI/Agentic Interface: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Model Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, custom scripts, evaluation frameworks, and real-time observability pipelines

Key Responsibilities

AI Function Leadership: Build and lead an AI-native engineering function with clear standards, fast shipping, and strong production discipline.

Core Infrastructure Improvement: Improve our core distributed systems, backend architectures, data ingestion layers, search, quoting, data management, payments, reporting, and internal copilots.

Agentic Harness Design: Design the harnesses that make agentic engineering reliable: repo instructions, skills, MCP tools, scripts, hooks, CI gates, evals, observability, permissions, and review loops.

Development Interface Execution: Use Claude Code, Codex, and related tools as a primary development interface, not an occasional assistant.

Non-Engineer Contribution Paths: Create a safe contribution path for non-engineers using AI tools, with rigorous engineering review loops at the right friction points.

Operational Systems Transformation: Turn messy, ambiguous operational constraints into simple, durable systems.

Team Development: Recruit, coach, and raise the engineering bar for a lean, elite engineering team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with growth, sales, operations, and finance to ship software that improves company revenue, margin, speed, and customer experience.

Qualifications

Hacker Mindset: You are a hacker in all aspects of life.

Full-Stack Depth: You are a strong full-stack engineer with a heavy backend bias.

Production Ownership: You have owned complex production systems that real customers or business operators depend on daily.

Startup DNA: You have experience with early-stage, high-growth tech environments, operating within lean and efficient teams.

Leadership Capabilities: You have strong leadership skills with experience in building, mentoring, and managing high-performing engineering teams or technical pods.

Agent Expert: You use coding agents every day and thoroughly understand their strengths, limitations, and failure modes from hands-on experience.

Interface Power-User: You frequently hit usage limits on Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools because you actively push them to execute real-world production code.

Concrete Portfolio: You have taken ultimate ownership and responsibility for an existing product or system before and possess a portfolio, GitHub repo, Loom, write-up, or concrete example of an application you built from scratch.
